hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU, 8151 MiB, 592.82; Windows-11-10.0.26200-SP0; Python 3.12.10
armB_components:
SQL retrieval (StructuredRetriever: exact filter / aggregate; msisdn guard)
Document retrieval (MiniLM FAISS top-10, CrossEncoder rerank, top 5)
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60)
Shared 6-block prompt limit
Cited answers ([E#]); same model, decoding and prompts in every arm
SciFact serving-time filter ON
No answer cache
No router, no semantic layer, no citation verification
armC_components:
Everything in B2: per-source budget 5 database + 3 document blocks (chosen from the E14a failure analysis on the same 22 questions; never tuned)
Semantic layer ON: ontology term normalisation (concept hint -> canonical terms in the FAISS query) + document-graph expansion (shared-concept bridges, gate weight)
Router ON: auto chain Laya fine-tuned -> embedding -> rule decides which sources are searched
Citation verification ON (project verifier, flags sentences, does not change the answer)
SciFact serving-time filter ON
No answer cache
connected_list:
SQL retrieval (StructuredRetriever) feeds the E14 pipeline
Document retrieval (FAISS + CrossEncoder) feeds the E14 pipeline
Per-source context budget (RagConfig) in B2 and C
Ontology concept hint and crosswalk category names used for query normalisation (arm C and the ontology ablation)
Document graph shared-concept bridges (graph_expand) merged by weighted RRF (arm C and the docgraph ablation)
QA router (Laya fine-tuned -> embedding -> rule) in arm C and the router ablation
Citation verifier (QA layer) applied to B and C answers
SciFact serving-time filter (all arms)

RELATED_TO links: 0 of 84 resolve to an indexed document, so the explicit see-also hop is unusable

Ontology on the SQL side (no cross-table traversal or entity linking)
Router's decomposition step: not used (E14 prompts are single-shot)
human_review_status: sample of 65 exported, not yet reviewed by a human
review_status_new: Unreviewed by a human: multi (7 questions written by Claude Code: MH01-05 and MH12-13); cross (6 questions: facts and document ids from Person B's frozen benchmark, but the question prefix and the atomic fact split were written by Claude Code); db held-out (7 questions: ground truth computed from SQLite for Person B's structured benchmark). The 22 core questions use the E14a gold.
repro_E14a: B (SciFact filter off) on the original 22: 84.1% (runs [84.1, 84.1, 84.1]) vs documented 79.5%. Differences from E14a: 3 runs instead of 1 (decoding is not deterministic here); no cached answers (E14a reused 5 of its 22 RAG answers from an earlier subset run); code and indexes as of commit 8e86ea9 (SciFact filter, msisdn guard and decomposer fix exist now); E14a recorded no package versions so the environment cannot be compared (torch/transformers/sentence-transformers/faiss dist-info dates precede E14a). Same: model qwen2.5:7b-instruct Q4_K_M, temperature 0, seed 42, E14a prompts and judge, shared 6-block budget, same 22 questions.
scifact_effect: On the 14 E14a document questions the old, SciFact-filtered and clean indexes return identical rankings (R@1 0.7857, MRR@10 0.8571; no SciFact chunk in any old top-10; docs/SCIFACT_INDEX_COMPARISON.md), and arm B on the original 22 scores 84.1% with the filter off versus 84.1% with it on (+0.0 pts; R@1 on the 14 document questions 0.786 vs 0.786).
dangling_links: 0 of 84 RELATED_TO links resolve to an indexed document in the graph used by arm C (knowledge_graph/output/graph.json, checked against the clean index); the corpus / related_ids fix for Person B's graph is not yet in.
